headline.zh: 临街整面玻璃+室外石凳
headline.en: Floor-to-ceiling street-facing glass + outdoor stone benches

traits.zh: 整面临街玻璃窗，采光良好
traits.en: Full-height street-facing glass windows with good natural light

traits.zh: 室外有四张石质长凳配软垫座位
traits.en: Four outdoor stone benches with cushioned seating

traits.zh: 供应贝果、司康等烘焙食品
traits.en: Serves bagels, scones, and other baked goods

linger.zh: 有固定室外软垫长凳，适合久坐
linger.en: Fixed outdoor cushioned benches support lingering

focus.zh: 木质吧台与简约绿植环境，非专注办公定位
focus.en: Wood bar and minimalist greenery suggest casual over focused work
